Figure 1:IsoFLOP curves (language objective).For a range of model sizes, we adjust the number of training tokens to maintain a constant final FLOPs, setting the cosine cycle length to match this target compute budget.
The distinct valley in the loss curve demonstrates that an optimal model size exists for any given FLOP budget.
Based on the locations of these minima, we project the compute-optimal model size and token count for larger scales.

Figure 2:Training curve envelope (language objective).Training curves are shown for all runs across varying values ofrr, encompassing various model sizes.
By extracting the envelope of minimal loss per FLOP from these curves, we estimate the optimal model size and training token allocation for a given compute budget.
